daily.title: Tokyo and Osaka record latest-ever day above 30 Celsius
daily.summary: Warm, humid air from the south swept across Japan, particularly areas along the Pacific coast, sending temperatures unusually high for late October.

daily.title: ¥4 billion in lottery proceeds to go to quake-hit Kumamoto
daily.summary: The money will be used for reconstruction projects in areas damaged by the powerful July 28 temblor.

daily.title: Japan tourist spending rises despite drop in visitor arrivals
daily.summary: The news comes as Japan approaches the one-year mark since Chinese authorities began issuing advisories urging citizens to avoid travel to Japan.

daily.title: Newly appointed farm minister apologizes over donation scandal
daily.summary: Arata Takebe, who only took office last week, has found himself at the center of a scandal over a political donation he received in 2014.

daily.title: Japan braces for 30th named storm this year as Typhoon Champi heads for Okinawa
daily.summary: The Japan Meteorological Agency says there will be high wind speeds of up to 216 kilometers per hour, as the super typhoon tracks toward Japan.

daily.title: Education ministry calls for University of Tokyo to review president selection
daily.summary: It is the first time the government has requested a review of how a university selected its president.

daily.title: One year on, LDP-JIP partnership still has some holes to fill
daily.summary: With deeper bonds between rank-and-file members of both parties lacking, the coalition is still more of a tie-up between the leaders.

daily.title: As residents of flood-hit Chiba Prefecture rebuild, concerns about the future linger
daily.summary: According to Chiba Prefecture's disaster response headquarters, 10 people have been killed and 37 injured in the prefecture by Typhoon Dujuan.

daily.title: Baku championships showcase rising standards in global sumo
daily.summary: The technical level of international amateur sumo is rising, with fewer mismatches and more competitive countries at the World Championships.

daily.title: BOJ likely to keep hiking rates every quarter, ex-official says
daily.summary: The Bank of Japan is widely expected to hold rates steady at its next policy meeting on Oct. 30.

daily.title: Japan demands access to journalist detained in Russia as spy row persists
daily.summary: A senior Japanese official met with his Russian counterpart, urging the "immediate release" of a Hokkaido Shimbun reporter.

daily.title: Nutritional quality of diets poorest among young people in Japan, survey finds
daily.summary: The research group that conducted the survey said developing good dietary habits early in life and maintaining them can lead to long-term health.

daily.title: 第7回 Satoyama実践者交流会を愛媛県内子町で開催

daily.title: Seventh Satoyama Practitioners Networking Event in Uchiko, Ehime
daily.summary: The Japan Times Cube Inc. will co-host the seventh Satoyama Practitioners Networking Event with the Ehime town of Uchiko on Nov. 14 and 15.

daily.title: Major banks in Japan accelerating shift to IC chip verification
daily.summary: The Financial Services Agency has urged financial institutions to review their cybersecurity measures amid repeated unauthorized access incidents.

daily.title: With leaders’ summit, ‘Quad’ hopes to breathe fresh life into grouping

daily.title: Japan envoy Sasakawa meets Myanmar’s Min Aung Hlaing, state media says
daily.summary: The meeting comes as international reengagement with the Southeast Asian nation has ramped up after years of diplomatic isolation.

daily.title: Japan to provide Malaysia with counterdrone system

daily.title: Japan to drop term ‘abnormal delivery’ to ease emotional burden on parents
daily.summary: The move follows concerns that the wording could cause psychological distress to expectant parents.

daily.title: Flour power: Nina Metayer brings her ‘world’s best’ pastries to Tokyo
daily.summary: The award-winning patissier's shop showcases the gorgeous creations that carved her reputation as one of France's top pastry talents.

daily.title: Tech sovereignty is fantasy. Control over choices is not.
daily.summary: Sovereignty is a tough nut to crack in a deeply interconnected, digital world.

daily.title: NFL Paris game to go forward with heightened security amid unrest

daily.title: Data breach potentially exposes information of 125,000 police officers and staff

daily.title: Ngumoha comes of age on breathless Anfield night

daily.title: French government to deploy troops and admits to failures over weekend unrest
daily.summary: The scale and the police's apparent inability to contain the turmoil has shocked France, inflaming tensions ahead of presidential elections next year.

daily.title: LeBron and Sixers spoil Knicks party as NBA season tips off

daily.title: Nearly defunct CRA receives ¥584 million in state subsidies

daily.title: Japan wins men’s team gold at world gymnastics championships
daily.summary: Japan prevailed under pressure, thanks in large part to an excellent routine from Daiki Hashimoto on the horizontal bar.

daily.title: Tiffany Ginza building asking price cut by a third as real estate market cools
daily.summary: The owner of the building has struggled to find buyers with an asking price of ¥120 billion, and is now open to offers as low as ¥80 billion.

daily.title: China’s super-rich scramble to exit offshore trusts, raise cash as taxman knocks
daily.summary: Some are selling shares and even switching nationality as a deadline looms to declare income booked overseas.
